subject: HealthPrime pilot: scope, milestones, and CS owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Mason <sarah.mason@healthprime.com>, procurement@healthprime.com
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: HealthPrime pilot: scope, milestones, and CS owners

Team — quick summary and ask to hand this over to CS. HealthPrime (pilot account) verbally committed last week; anticipated pilot start: week of 3/13. High-level: 3-week pilot, 2 production-facing endpoints (inference + embeddings), expected peak concurrency ~40 rps, monthly spend estimate ~$28k during pilot.

Attachments: HealthPrime_SOW_v1.pdf, Integration_Requirements.xlsx, Mutual_Action_Plan_v0.3.docx (see links below). Procurement is circulating final contract (DocuSign link) — signature expected by 3/9.

What I need from CS:
- Confirm primary CS owner and secondary backup.
- Run an internal pre-kickoff (30m) to review integration requirements and rollout milestones (target 3/9).
- Confirm kickoff date with HealthPrime (they prefer mornings PST).

Open risks:
- HealthPrime requires IP allowlisting and a stricter RBAC setup for their test cluster; integration spreadsheet notes their AWS account IDs.
- They requested SAML SSO for console access after pilot — not blocking pilot but flags implementation work.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

---
Referenced links: DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/HP-2028-042
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Mason <sarah.mason@healthprime.com>, procurement@healthprime.com
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: HealthPrime pilot: scope, milestones, and CS owners

Thanks Ben — I can take point on orchestration and program-level communication and propose Vivek as the day-to-day implementation lead. Proposed split:
- Soojin (me): Program lead, exec touchpoints, SLA/account escalations.
- Vivek: Primary implementation owner — kickoff, runbooks, technical triage, go/no-go checks.

Next steps from CS side:
1) Vivek and I will run a 30-minute internal pre-kickoff on 3/09 to review the Integration_Requirements.xlsx and confirm resource availability.
2) We'll propose 3/14 or 3/15 for the customer-facing kickoff (mornings PST) — Ben, please confirm HealthPrime availability.
3) Vivek: can you confirm you have access to the integration workbook and the SOW? I didn’t see a stated target RTO for the embeddings endpoint — Ben, can you confirm if <100ms mean latency is an explicit requirement?

I will also prepare a short deployment checklist and owner RACI to attach to the kickoff.

Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | x472

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 19:01:00 +0000
Subject: Re: HealthPrime pilot: scope, milestones, and CS owners

Happy to own the implementation work. Quick answers / asks:
- I have the two attached files; downloading now and will annotate the Integration_Requirements.xlsx with questions by EOD 3/6.
- Ben: please confirm HealthPrime's AWS account IDs (they're in the sheet but I'd like a double-check) and whether they require traffic to originate from a static egress IP range or use VPC peering. That impacts deployment options.
- On latency: if <100ms is firm for embeddings in production, we should call out model variants / quantization decisions in the playbook. For pilot, acceptable to run with t2 (standard) profile but we should flag regressions if they plan to scale.

Internal pre-kickoff: 3/9 at 10:00am PT works for me. I'll prepare a short slide with acceptance criteria and go/no-go gates.

Vivek
Senior Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Candidate kickoff windows (all mornings PST):
- Tue 3/14 09:30–10:15 PT
- Wed 3/15 09:30–10:15 PT

Agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions + success criteria (5m)
- Integration checklist review (10m)
- Deployment plan & roles (10m)
- Next steps & timeline (5–10m)

Please confirm which slot works and add your IT contact (we've requested Rajiv Patel). I’ve included the DocuSign link for the SOW; procurement should have the final signature by early next week.

Ben

Thanks, Ben — Wed 3/15 09:30 PT works best for our team. Rajiv (cc'd) will join from IT and will review the Integration_Requirements.xlsx prior to the call. A couple of notes up front:
- We need network allowlist entries (we'll provide CIDR ranges for our env).
- We also require per-tenant audit logs retained for 90 days during pilot — can Redwood share logging retention & export capabilities?
- We completed your security questionnaire; uploaded a short summary here: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/security-questionnaire/healthprime

We'll sign the SOW by Monday. See you on 3/15.
